entries.title: D2: Deal Score Range & Formula (F02)
entries.summary: ## D2: Deal Score Range & Formula (F02) - **Problem**: Need an intuitive 0–100 score indicating discount depth while avoiding confusion with 0 (broken) and 100 (unrealistic perfection). - **Decision**: Formula `dealScore = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Math.round((1 - ratio) * 130)))`.

entries.title: D3: Zero-Build Static PWA Architecture
entries.summary: ## D3: Zero-Build Static PWA Architecture - **Decision**: Keep application strictly static (no bundler, no node runtime needed to deploy). - Use vendored Leaflet and Lucide UMD bundles. - Rely on native ES Modules and browser web standards.
